notes: Accessed directly via Chrome (Shopify storefront; robots.txt explicitly welcomes crawling, no Claude-specific disallow, Sitemap: https://thepurpleturtles.com/sitemap.xml). Site canonicalizes to non-www (thepurpleturtles.com); www. redirects there, so links use the non-www canonical. Despite the prior Home-Decor pass's note that this is largely a decor/lighting/tableware brand, it DOES carry a real furniture assortment: a header mega-menu 'Furniture' department with 5 children (Tables, Chairs & Stools, Bench, Storage & Cabinets, Sofa). Per Trap #1 (mandatory sitemap cross-check), the plain-text collection index at /pages/sitemap surfaced 6 additional furniture-named collections NOT in the header nav or in the mega-menu's own /collections/furniture tile strip: Al Fresco Furniture and Furnishings, Outdoor Furnitures, Garden Benches, Garden Chairs & Stools, Garden Tables, Cast Iron Bench (plus two non-furniture siblings, Garden Decor and Accessories and Gardening Essentials, excluded as out of scope). These carry stale SEO titles referencing a defunct 'Beruru' sub-brand; 5 of the 6 (all except Al Fresco) return HTTP 200 with the site's own 'This collection is empty' state and 0 products via /collections/<handle>/products.json -- emitted per brief 7b-Trap4 as qty:0 leaf rows rather than omitted, since they are live nodes (200, not 404), not orphans. Al Fresco Furniture and Furnishings is live with 13 products; title/product_type inspection found only 6 are furniture (1 Bookcase, 1 Console Table, 1 Coffee Table, 3 Almirahs) vs 7 excluded non-furniture (2 Trays, 4 Pots, 1 Wall Mirror). Note the 3 Almirahs (Arhu Old Wood Almirah, Nafs Teakwood Almirah, Karhu Teakwood Almirah) are exact-title duplicates already counted under Storage & Cabinets -- kept in both rows since they are two genuinely different site listing pages/URLs (per output-contract rule), flagged here rather than dropped silently. QTY METHOD: for every collection, enumerated unique product ids via same-origin fetch to /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 (paged, deduped by id) -- Shopify's /collections.json 'products_count' field was re-confirmed grossly inflated on this store (e.g. furniture handle shows 2123 vs true supportable total ~508 on that page's own availability facets) so it was never used. Corroborated once: on Tables, the page's own Availability facet (In stock 54 + Out of stock 49 = 103) vs unique-id enumeration (102) differed by exactly 1, consistent with one product having split-availability variants counted in both facets -- enumeration (the more precise unique-product count) was used throughout. EXCLUSIONS applied via product_type + title inspection on the full per-collection product dump (not a sample): Tables (102 raw -> 101 kept): dropped 1 candle stand (Nyarai Brass Antique With Bronze Candle Stand, product_type Candle Stands). Bench (59 raw -> 51 kept): dropped 7 standalone storage boxes (product_type Box/Storage Box) and 1 hardware bracket set (LAHJA BRACKET SET OF 2); kept 4 'Rack'-typed items (3 large freestanding display racks measured 94-113cm wide x 137-182cm tall, clearly furniture-scale, plus 1 book rack) and all Cabinet/Console/Table/Bench items. Storage & Cabinets (132 raw -> 126 kept): dropped 6 standalone storage boxes (product_type Storage Box/Storage Boxes); kept Chest Box-typed items (site's own description calls them usable 'as a storage cabinet as well as a console'), Cabinets & Storage-typed almirahs/chests, 1 Rack and 1 Shelf (both filed under this furniture department, no contradicting evidence found). Chairs & Stools (11) and Sofa (7): no exclusions found. The 'Furniture' parent collection page itself (508 products via its own availability facets) was NOT recorded as a row -- it is a superset that also includes ~200 Mirror-tagged products outside the 5 named children, so per the URL-hierarchy rule only the 5 real children (plus the separately-discovered Outdoor/Garden nodes) were recorded as leaves.
